title: UniRoboLab policy contract (v0 draft)
description: Single source of truth for how a policy observes and acts. Both the training environment and the generated ROS 2 node are derived from this.

urdf.description: Path to the URDF used in both training and deployment.

joints.description: Canonical joint order. Every observation/action term that refers to joints uses this order.

sim_dt_s.description: Physics step used in training. The generated node checks that the real controller rate matches policy_rate_hz.

observations.description: Concatenated in this order to form the policy input.

actions.description: Policy output is split in this order.

ros.description: How the generated ROS 2 node reaches the robot. Defaults derive from namespace.

namespace.description: Robot namespace, e.g. ServoDemo. Topics default to /<namespace>/...

command_topic.description: Default /<namespace>/joint_command (sensor_msgs/JointState, as the simulator and topic_based_ros2_control expect)

command_mode.description: joint_state_topic publishes JointState on command_topic; ros2_control_commands publishes Float64MultiArray on /<namespace>/<controller_name>/commands

goal_topic.description: Float64MultiArray feeding the 'command' observation. Default /<namespace>/policy/command. Status/debug topics live next to it.

ground_truth_topic.description: geometry_msgs/PoseStamped with the base pose (the simulator's ground truth; on a real robot, odometry/localization). Needed when the contract observes base_* / projected_gravity / imu_orientation / base_goal_xy. Default /<namespace>/ground_truth

imu_topic.description: sensor_msgs/Imu; supplies base_ang_vel and imu_orientation/projected_gravity when set (takes precedence over ground truth)

odom_topic.description: nav_msgs/Odometry; supplies base_lin_vel (twist in the child frame) and the pose when set

cmd_vel_topic.description: geometry_msgs/Twist published by base_twist actions. Default /<namespace>/cmd_vel

safety.description: Runtime guards applied by the deployed node (and reported in its status). All optional.

max_obs_age_s.description: Stop commanding when joint_states (or the base pose, if used) is older than this. Default 3 policy periods.

joint_limits.description: Per-joint [lower, upper] clamp on position targets (rad or m).

max_joint_speed.description: Clamp: velocity targets to +-v; position targets so they move at most v * period per step (scalar or per joint).

max_joint_effort.description: Clamp on effort targets (N*m or N).

max_base_speed.description: [linear m/s, angular rad/s] clamp for base_twist actions.

ramp_in_s.description: Blend from the measured state to the policy targets over this time at start and after every safe stop. Default 1.0.

estop_topic.description: std_msgs/Bool; true stops commanding until false. Default /<namespace>/policy/estop

stop_action.description: What a safe stop publishes: hold = stop publishing (drives keep their last target), zero = zero velocity/effort targets once.

source.description: base_* / projected_gravity / imu_orientation are in the body frame (ROS axes). base_goal_xy (size 2) is the task goal on the ground expressed in the body frame; the deployed node builds it from the goal topic (world x, y) and the robot pose.

joints.description: Subset of robot.joints, in robot.joints order. Omit for all joints.

scale.description: Scalar or one value per element of the term.

offset.description: Scalar or one value per element (e.g. default joint positions for joint_pos_rel).

deadband.description: Values with |x| below this are zeroed before scaling. Use for sensors that never rest at exactly zero.

ros_topic.description: Override of the ROS 2 source topic in the generated node.

size.description: Required for source=command/custom. Joint sources take their size from joints; last_action from the action layout.

ros_type.description: For source=command: message type of the goal topic. twist packs [linear.x, linear.y, angular.z] (size must be 3).

target.description: joints: joint commands; base_twist: geometry_msgs/Twist on ros.cmd_vel_topic (size 2 = [vx, wz], size 3 = [vx, vy, wz])

scale.description: Scalar or one value per element of the term.

offset.description: Scalar or one value per element (e.g. default joint positions for joint_pos_rel).

size.description: Required for target=custom; base_twist defaults to 2.

action_term.description: Processing order on the raw policy output: clip -> *scale + offset -> publish.
